title: Spells & abilities

fields.label: Range Maximum + 1
fields.notes: Value must be 1 greater than in-game value: 1=0, 2=1, 3=2, etc.

fields.label: Range Minimum
fields.notes: Value of 0 means you may target yourself.

fields.label: Target Area (0,1 = 1)
fields.notes: Value of either 0 or 1 equal Area of 1.

fields.label: Strikes (0,1 = 1)
fields.notes: Default only has > 0 values for Summon Effects, so I assume this is similar to Area.

fields.label: Exclude from AI manual actions
fields.notes: In Reborn 1.0.2, the AI action builder calls a strict usability check which rejects manual actions with this flag set before simulating their effects (RVA 0x3BE7F3, error 9). Automatic skills bypass this particular check. This flag does not repair native status scoring; AI Plus handles that separately. Other callers of the strict usability check may also honor it.

fields.label: Damage Scaling
fields.notes: This field is currently configured as Health Point Damage type to support the common HP Damage (1) Process.nIt should also be able to support Health Point Restore and Magic Point Damage type values, but I do not have a list for the first or a module for the second.
